item.title: 【HD Live Performances】UPSCALE - Charli XCX - 365 Coachella Music Festival (Weekend 2) (UPSCALE)
item.description:
I wanted to test upscaling Charli XCX’s Coachella 2025 performance since I was actually there this year, and this show will always be special to me. I ran the Coachella Replay stream through Topaz Video AI (Proteus) to clean up the compression and pixelation. I used strong noise reduction and compression fix to smooth out the blocky dark areas, added subtle sharpening and a touch of grain to keep the image natural, and exported in 4K, H.265 (HEVC) 10-bit with AAC 2.0 audio. The result is much sharper and more cinematic, especially in the darker crowd shots, and a big step up from the original replay. If you have any feedback, that would be fab
